_comment: Third-party assets for the rig. Schema v2: one entry per asset with id, kind (texture/hdri/model/decal), source, url, licence, resolution and path (relative to sim/assets/third_party/, or a URL when remote). Run sim/tools/fetch_assets.py to download; see sim/assets/README.md for the catalogue.
